lines.text: Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes, Commander?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I was just about to go meet you in the Commander's Room.
No, don't come.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Has something happened?
I'll be staying with D for a while.
Rapi doesn't respond for a while.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Might I ask why?
Because my head may be on the chopping block fairly soon.
Apparently I've been designated as a target.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm coming over right now.
No, don't. The situation isn't critical, at least not yet.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: So you say. I'm keeping an eye on you until D leaves.
That won't be necessary.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But...
I'll call you immediately if things go wrong.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Perilous Siege doesn't kill people wantonly.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: There has to have been some kind of misunderstanding.
That's what I'm thinking as well.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Call me if things go south.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'll be there whenever you need me.
